title: feat(remote): support container & pod clone
body:
#### Checklist

- [x] I have read and understood our contributing guidelines ...
- [x] PR description, commit message, and GitHub comments are human-written, per LLM Policy
- [x] Certify you wrote the patch ... Signed-off-by line in all commits ...
- [x] Referenced issues using `Fixes: #00000` in commit message (if applicable)
- [x] Tests have been added/updated (or no tests are needed)
- [x] Documentation has been updated (or no documentation changes are needed)
- [x] All commits pass `make validatepr` (format/lint checks)
- [x] Release note entered in the section below (or `None` if no user-facing changes)

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

I split the PR in two commits to ease review (I can squash them if preferred) one for container, one for pod. (Both target https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29975)

```release-note
Support podman pod clone & podman container clone on remote target
```

disclose: I used AI to help me implement the fix
